_help: Money switches for OverScope. Both are OFF until you fill them in. After editing, commit to GitHub — the Action rebuilds the site. See README → 'Turning on tips or ads'.

tip.label: Support OverScope
tip._help: Paste your Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, GitHub Sponsors or Patreon page address, e.g. https://ko-fi.com/yourname. Leave empty to hide the link.

ads._help: Only switch on after choosing an ad network. hosts = the web addresses the network's code loads from (it gives you these). headHtml = the code it says to put in <head>. slotHtml = the code for one ad box. consentReady must be true, confirming a cookie-consent pop-up is set up (the network or a consent tool provides it) — ads track visitors, so the build refuses to turn them on without it.
